zh: 一个数至多 10 位，它经过至多一次交换能变成的不同数只有 1+d(d−1)/2 个（不交换，加上每一对位置的交换），数量很小，可以直接枚举，而不必逐对比较 n² 个数对。
从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录此前每个值出现的次数。对当前数 numbers[j]，枚举它不交换以及交换一对位置后得到的所有合法数，把它们在此前出现的次数加起来，就是以 j 为右端点的有效数对个数。交换两个相同数字没有变化，把 0 换到首位会产生前导零，这两种都要跳过；交换两个不同数字时，不同的位置对得到的结果互不相同，不会重复计数。
维护哈希表 freq（初始为空）和 64 位答案 ans。对每个数：转成十进制串 s，先把 freq[s] 加入 ans；再对每对位置 i<j，若 s[i]≠s[j] 且不是 i 为首位而 s[j] 为 0，就交换得到 t，把 freq[t] 加入 ans 后再换回；最后令 freq[s] 加一。处理完所有数后输出 ans。
en: A number has at most 10 digits, so it can turn into only 1 + d(d-1)/2 different numbers with at most one swap (no swap, plus one swap per pair of positions). That is small enough to enumerate directly instead of comparing all n^2 pairs.

Scan left to right and keep a hash map with how many times each value has appeared so far. For the current number numbers[j], enumerate every valid number obtained with no swap or with one swap of a pair of positions; the sum of their earlier occurrence counts is the number of valid pairs whose right end is j. Swapping two equal digits changes nothing and moving a 0 to the front creates a leading zero, so skip both; swaps of two different digits at different position pairs give pairwise different results, so nothing is counted twice.

Keep a hash map freq (initially empty) and a 64-bit answer ans. For each number: turn it into its decimal string s and add freq[s] to ans; then for every pair of positions i < j with s[i] != s[j], unless i is the first position and s[j] is 0, swap to get t, add freq[t] to ans, and swap back; finally increment freq[s]. After all numbers, print ans.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Process from left to right. Enumerate the valid representations the current number can form with no swap and with a swap of any pair of distinct positions, and accumulate the counts using prefix frequencies.

## Proof of correctness

Each prefix position is counted once. The enumerated set contains exactly the results of at most one valid swap; summing, for each result in the set, the number of its earlier occurrences counts every valid pair whose right endpoint is the current index exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(n d^2), d<=10; space O(n d^2) in the worst case.

## Source notes

This site supplied a deterministic standard input/output protocol. In upstream problem 9, the dense-arrival example omitted the completion time of one admitted guest; this site corrected it to 3301 according to the explicit 300-second service and queue rules, and states this truthfully in the source evidence.
